rootCauses: Private-sport Cards links targeted /fantasy/packs, which had no page and fell through to the generic fantasy-tab notFound branch.
The not-found terminal screen did not signal StartupReady, hiding the 404 behind the startup overlay until its 45-second timeout.

The previous loading update introduced READ ONLY on the wallet projection transaction. Real admission/trading functions acquire FOR SHARE row locks and PostgreSQL rejected them with SQLSTATE 25006. Previous tests stubbed these functions and missed this incompatibility.
My packs links used tab=mine while the shop only read packs=mine.
repairs: Explicit server route redirects old Packs URLs to the existing authenticated pack shop, preserving sport and selected tab.
Cards links use the shared canonical pack-shop URL directly.
Not-found and pack permission-denied screens release startup loading.
Wallet projections retain repeatable-read snapshots without READ ONLY, preserving admission row locks and the existing mutation settlement lock. No security functions changed.
